'''Aambler''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], selling ordnance to Imperial-aligned individuals<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|1}} As all Imperial events on Balmorra, for which Aambler is present, occur during Act I, Aambler's presence on Balmorra therefore must have happened in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> in [[Gorinth Canyon]].<ref name="TOR" />
